description:
Longer Range, Less Worry

Experience a real-world 40% boost in range compared to standard batteries. Whether you’re commuting, exploring, or running errands, our battery delivers up to 80 miles per charge—so you ride longer and recharge less.

20% Torque Boost

Tired of losing speed on hills or struggling with heavy loads? Rebel.2 Pro engineered 1300W high-torque motor delivers 20% more torque—giving you the raw power to tackle steep inclines, accelerate faster from stops.

Smooth starts under heavy loads, no lag or struggle

Strong hill climbs with full cargo or a passenger on board

Stable, consistent power for safer, more controlled riding

5 Smart Riding Modes

Five riding modes deliver the speed and power to own the road as a Class 1, 2, or 3 eBike. Our system ensures you’re always riding compliantly.

Access maximum power output and reach exhilarating speeds up to 30 mph on private roads or designated areas

Almost Fully Assembled

95% pre assembled. You only need to install the pedals and connect the handlebars. We will deliver Rebel.2 Pro folding electric bike directly to your doorstep with all wheels already connected, requiring only minimal assembly.

NFC Unlock, Keyless Access

The advanced settings allow you to fully personalize the pedal assist (PAS) experience. You can individually define the power output—from 1% to 100%—for each of the 5 assistance levels.

*For a safe and comfortable start, we recommend beginning with a moderate acceleration setting.

Next-Generation Folding Footrest

Discover enhanced comfort & space-saving design. This upgraded footrest offers a wider contact surface for increased stability and comfort, while its innovative folding mechanism maximizes convenience by saving space when not in use.

Ultra-Comfort Focused

• Engineered for Comfort:Significantly widened to match the natural contour of your hips.
• Even Pressure Distribution:Disperses weight across the entire seat area, not just pressure points.
• Key Benefit:Delivers stable support andfundamentally reduces fatigueon long rides.

20" *3.0" Tires

The brown color adds a sense of style. Excellent puncture resistance and premium rubber, abrasion resistance, suitable for urban and rural road driving on wet, cement, asphalt and steep pavement.
